summary: Install many roles from a requirements.yml (extension must be .yml or .yaml) with ansible-galaxy install -r. Each entry can set src, scm (git or hg), version and name.
questions: How do I install several roles at once?
What fields can I use in a roles requirements.yml?
Why does ansible-galaxy misread my requirements file?
What's the default version if I don't set one in requirements.yml?

answer_card.title: Install roles from requirements.yml
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml
```
The file must end in `.yml` or `.yaml`, otherwise it's read in the old deprecated format.

Per-role keys:
- `src` (required): `namespace.role_name` for Galaxy, or an SCM URL
- `scm`: `git` (default) or `hg`
- `version`: tag, commit or branch (default: repo's default branch, else `master`)
- `name`: install under this name
